Google launches Gemma 4, its “most intelligent” open model family, purpose-built for advanced reasoning and agentic workflows, under an Apache 2.0 license   —  C  —  O  —  Group Product Manager, Google DeepMind  —  Today, we are introducing Gemma 4 — our most intelligent open models to date.
